CMS Definition: Blank (No footnote; standard reported metric or unannotated)
Documented Application: Standard public data publication without exception or suppression annotation.

CMS Definition: Results are not available for this reporting period.
Documented Application: Results were not available from CMS for the specified reporting period.

CMS Definition: The number of cases/patients is too few to report.
Documented Application: The hospital did not meet the minimum case threshold for public reporting, had too few cases to reliably assess performance, or data was suppressed to protect personal health information.

CMS Definition: This measure was calculated using partial performance period data due to a CMS-approved exception.
Documented Application: Results were based on less than the maximum possible performance period, but not all quarters, due to a CMS-approved Extraordinary Circumstances Exception affecting one or more quarters.

CMS Definition: No cases met the criteria for this measure.
Documented Application: No cases treated at the hospital met the inclusion criteria for the specific condition measure during the performance window.
